name: Smooth Scrolling
author: Saeed Piri

sections.description:
📜 Elevate your site’s scrolling experience instantly. No settings needed, Engage visitors with effortless transitions that keep them scrolling longer. Install in seconds!

Features

✔️ Mouse wheel, middle mouse and keyboard support
⌨️ Arrow keys, PgUp/PgDown, Spacebar, Home/End
💻 Full touchpad support
🧠 Smart Include and Exclude loading rules.
⚙️ Advanced tuning for frame rate, animation time, step size, acceleration, pulse scale, keyboard step size, and feature toggles.
🚀 Script loading controls for defer/async behavior, footer loading, and fetch priority.

— Scroll smoothly 😌

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smooth-scrolling directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Smooth scrolling is enabled across the front end by default.
  4. Go to Settings > Smooth Scrolling to customize loading rules and advanced behavior.
    That is it 🙂
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work immediately after activation?

Yes. Smooth scrolling is enabled across the entire front end by default.

Can I load Smooth Scrolling only on specific pages?

Yes. Use the Include rules on the settings page to define exactly where the script should load.

What happens if I leave Include rules empty?

The plugin loads across the entire front end unless an Exclude rule matches the current page.

Can I change the scroll speed and animation feel?

Yes. The Advanced Scroll Tuning section lets you adjust frame rate, animation time, step size, acceleration, pulse scale, keyboard step size, and feature toggles.

Does the plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin only controls frontend script loading and scrolling behavior. It does not collect or store visitor personal data.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

Release Date – 9 July 2026 | 1405/4/18

  • Added a modern settings page under Settings > Smooth Scrolling.
  • Added smart Include and Exclude loading rules.
  • Added support for page, post, post type, taxonomy term, archive, search, 404, template, and URL-based conditions.
  • Added advanced scroll tuning controls for the bundled SmoothScroll engine.
  • Added script loading controls for strategy, footer loading, and fetch priority.
  • Added a reset-to-defaults button for advanced tuning values.
  • Added RTL-friendly and LTR-friendly glassmorphism admin styles.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0

1.0.1

Release Date – 18 April 2025 | 1404/1/29

  • Tested up to WordPress 6.8.
  • Minor code improvements.

1.0

  • Initial public release.
